info.description: NewsBase Headlines serves news from Google News RSS editions and major outlets' own RSS feeds (BBC, NPR, The Guardian, Al Jazeera, The New York Times), parsed and normalized on our server. It is built against the two failures news API users complain about most: every response is serialized by us from typed records, so it is valid JSON by construction, and article images are the publishers' own URLs returned directly - there is no image proxy to break. Endpoints cover top headlines for any country/language edition Google News publishes, full-text search, the eight standard topic sections, and per-outlet feeds. Feeds are cached briefly, and if an upstream feed fails, the last good edition is served with a stale flag instead of an error. Errors are always structured JSON objects that name the problem.
